description: This Java class 'CreatePolicySubstitutionStrategy' provides a mechanism to perform substitution within a 'CreatePolicy' command, specifically handling placeholders for 'SubjectId' inside the command and producing a modified version if needed.

classes.name: CreatePolicySubstitutionStrategy
